This is my small rice plot, just a small piece near the dambo where the water sits. I am young and I do not have much cash, but my family gave me a little from last harvest of maize to buy some fertilizer. I will put some urea because rice without fertilizer gives very little, but I cannot buy a full bag just for this small plot — I will share with my uncle who also has rice nearby. I will use the seed I kept from last year because improved rice seed is hard to find here and costs too much, and I will do most of the work myself with my younger brother helping.
